none: PAS NLM-94BED2: Roman Nummus of Constantius II from Swinhope
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Constantius II (323-361), issue of 323-324, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Bust cuirassed left, encrusted. Obverse inscription: [--]NSTAN[--]. Reverse description: Globe on altar. Reverse inscription: probably [BEATATRAN QVILLITAS]. Diameter: 18.3mm, Weight: 1.61gms, die axis: 6
